Last year, I had a wedding, the biggest event in my life.

YouTube has helped me grow so much,
and more than anything, thanks to YouTube(?), I met my current wife,
so I really wanted to capture it in a video.

I've finally finished editing,
and I'm here to share this good news.

This year, I'll be more than just working,
but I'll also be visiting you often through videos.
Good night!

3 minutes
